_about: Relics and the damage meter. Owner: Role Building. Relics are offered only after boss wins and charge from the damage meter, never a random roll. The meter rules are from the design doc; every relic below is PROPOSED.

meter.note: PROPOSED reading of 'each relic names its own trigger' with 'relics charge from a meter': a fill gives each relic one charge, and the relic spends it the next time its own trigger happens (an 'on_fill' relic spends it at once). Charges not spent by the end of the fight are lost. Damage counts as the number shown, overkill included, as in the prototype.

offer.boost_rule: A boss's loot boost multiplies that rarity's weight: '+75% Rare' means rare weight x 1.75.
offer.note: No cap on relics held: a run has at most 5 boss wins, so the cap never bites. Mage rank 3 adds 3.0 s to every relic with a duration; rank 5 doubles power and duration.

triggers.on_attack: the next basic attack by any ally after the charge
triggers.on_hit_taken: the next time any ally is hit after the charge; applies to that ally
triggers.on_ally_ko: the next time an ally is knocked out after the charge

whetstone_charm.name: Whetstone Charm
whetstone_charm.text: All allies deal 15% more attack damage for 4 s.

tin_bell_ward.name: Tin Bell Ward
tin_bell_ward.text: The struck ally gains a shield worth 20% of its max HP for 4 s.

kindling_pouch.name: Kindling Pouch
kindling_pouch.text: That attack sets a flame sprite on its target: 3% max HP per second for 3 s.

rally_horn.name: Rally Horn
rally_horn.text: When an ally is knocked out, the rest gain 25% attack speed for 5 s.

moss_poultice.name: Moss Poultice
moss_poultice.text: All allies heal 10% of their max HP over 3 s.

gust_chime.name: Gust Chime
gust_chime.text: That attack knocks its target up, stunning it for 1.0 s.

mirror_pane.name: Mirror Pane
mirror_pane.text: For 3 s the struck ally returns 30% of damage taken as magic damage.

sigil_lantern.name: Sigil Lantern
sigil_lantern.text: Marks the healthiest enemy with a glowing sigil: it takes 20% more damage for 5 s.

second_wind_plume.name: Second Wind Plume
second_wind_plume.text: When an ally is knocked out, its nearest ally heals 30% of its max HP.

tempest_compass.name: Tempest Compass
tempest_compass.text: All enemies are slowed (attack speed x0.7) for 4 s.

brandfire_censer.name: Brandfire Censer
brandfire_censer.text: That attack leaps to 3 more enemies for 100% attack damage as magic.

heart_of_the_pit.name: Heart of the Pit
heart_of_the_pit.text: All allies gain a shield worth 30% of their max HP and 20% attack damage for 5 s.

starfall_locket.name: Starfall Locket
starfall_locket.text: Stars fall on every enemy for 8% of its max HP as true damage.

rules_kept: No relic revives: only the Healer class revives (design).
No 'at fight start' relic yet: under the meter rule it could only fire on the first fill. Say if you want fight-start relics to skip the meter.
